title: Jesse Kinder
text:
Background
I am a computational and theoretical physicist who loves to teach. I enjoy working with students on research projects and bringing contemporary physics research into the classroom.

Ph.D., Physics and Astronomy, University of Pennsylvania
M.S., Physics and Astronomy, University of Pennsylvania
B.A., Physics and Astronomy, DePauw University

title: Jesse Kinder
text:
Research
Nanotechnology, quantum chemistry, biological physics, epidemic models, radio astronomy, gravitational lensing, and quantum computing. My doctoral work modified the electronic and optical properties of carbon nanotubes using electromagnetic fields.

Grades, assignments, and office hours for enrolled students are in Canvas. Everyone else can reach me through the OIT directory.
